insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.

room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent as Reasonable and Customary charges with no explicit sub-limit on room category

icu.note: ICU/ICCU covered as Reasonable and Customary charges with no explicit sub-limit stated

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, HIV, hazardous sports, several specific conditions capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹75k (Plan A)/₹1L (Plan B); Modern treatments individually sub-limited (e.g. robotic surgery ₹5L, oral chemo ₹1L); HIV: ₹2L/₹5L; Hazardous sports: 10% of SI; Genetic diseases: 25% SI; ARMD: ₹1L; Puberty/menopause: 25% SI; Behavioural disorders: 25% SI; Maternity: ₹50k/₹1L

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, renal disorders, skin disorders, gallstones, etc.; 36-month wait for joint replacement, ARMD, genetic diseases, mental illness; 90-day wait for diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait); ₹50k Plan A / ₹1L Plan B
maternity.note: Inbuilt cover after 36 months continuous coverage in this policy; max 2 claims lifetime; inpatient only in India; newborn covered till policy expiry

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy defines Claim Free Year but does not specify a cumulative/no-claim bonus percentage in the wording provided

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 60 days before admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 90 days after discharge

day_care.note: Extensive list of day-care procedures covered as per Annexure I

domiciliary.note: Clause 4.4.14 explicitly excludes domiciliary hospitalisation expenses

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of donor covered (excluding cost of organ) within available Sum Insured

ambulance.display: Up to ₹1,00,000 per illness + ₹10,000 for return
ambulance.note: Road and air ambulance up to ₹1,00,000 per illness for admission/transfer; additional ₹10,000 for hospital-to-home if certified by doctor

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual sub-limits: robotic surgery ₹5L, deep brain stimulation ₹5L, stereotactic radiosurgery ₹3L, bronchial thermoplasty ₹2.5L, others lower

consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items as not payable; no consumables rider available

global_cover.note: Clause 4.4.15 and Section 5.3 explicitly restrict cover to treatment taken in India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; credit for PED waiting, specific waiting periods and moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, dental (non-accident), vaccination, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen, acupressure/acupuncture, venereal disease, convalescence

optional_riders.display: None mentioned in wording; Plan A and Plan B are the two coverage tiers with differing limits
